rules.title: Label isn't in the project's rules
rules.fix: Use one of the labels in the project rules (see `allowed`), or propose a rules change that adds it.

rules.title: Label is a synonym of a canonical label
rules.fix: Use the canonical label name; the normaliser rewrites synonyms on write.

rules.title: Geometry not allowed for this label
rules.fix: Draw this label with one of its allowed geometries (see `allowed`).

rules.title: Rules change would orphan annotations
rules.fix: Merge the label into another with labels.merge (or rename it with labels.rename) instead of removing it; the message gives the count.

rules.title: Rename target is already a label
rules.fix: Merge into the existing label with labels.merge instead of renaming onto it.

rules.title: Annotation is malformed
rules.fix: Send a well-formed annotation: id, itemId, label, provenance, author, createdAt and a geometry with a type (see the message).

rules.title: Annotation lies outside the image
rules.fix: Keep the geometry inside the image extent; clip it or redraw it.

rules.title: Annotation is smaller than the minimum size
rules.fix: Redraw it at least `annotations.minSize` across, or delete it if it was a stray click.

rules.title: Required attribute missing
rules.fix: Set every attribute listed in `annotations.requiredAttributes` and the label's attribute schema.

rules.title: Dataset name already used in this project
rules.fix: Pick another name, or add the files to the existing dataset.

rules.title: Required dataset metadata missing
rules.fix: Fill in every field in `datasets.requiredMetadata` (modality, license, source, description).

rules.title: Dataset mixes modalities
rules.fix: Put each modality in its own dataset.

rules.title: File is outside the project's folder layout
rules.fix: Move the file under one of `layout.folderPatterns`, within `layout.maxDepth`.

rules.title: Path contains forbidden characters
rules.fix: Remove the characters listed in `layout.forbiddenCharacters` from the path.

rules.title: Path is deeper than the layout allows
rules.fix: Use a shallower folder, within `layout.maxDepth`.

rules.title: Name doesn't match the naming rules
rules.fix: Rename it to match `layout.fileNamePattern` without `layout.forbiddenCharacters`; trimming and NFC are applied on write.

rules.title: Name may contain personal health information
rules.fix: Rename it with a pseudonymous id; never use patient names, dates of birth or record numbers.

rules.title: Environment doesn't resolve
rules.fix: Fix the references the resolver reports (modules, renderers, tools) using the catalogue.

rules.title: Studio labels differ from the project's rules
rules.fix: Use the project's labels in the Studio, or propose a rules change.

rules.title: DICOM series is incomplete
rules.fix: Upload the missing instances (see the slice gaps), or remove the partial series.

rules.title: SEG frame of reference doesn't match its source
rules.fix: Regenerate the segmentation against the referenced series.

rules.title: NIfTI qform and sform disagree
rules.fix: Rewrite the header with one consistent affine (qform = sform).

rules.title: DICOM series has uneven slice or pixel spacing
rules.fix: Check the series for missing or duplicated slices, or resample it to even spacing.

rules.title: DICOM series mixes slice orientations
rules.fix: Split the series: its slices belong to more than one volume.

rules.title: DICOM file fails conformance checks (dciodvfy)
rules.fix: Fix the attributes dciodvfy reports, or re-export from the source system.

rules.title: NIfTI voxel size is zero, negative or not finite
rules.fix: Set positive voxel sizes (pixdim) in the header.

rules.title: NIfTI image contains NaN voxels
rules.fix: Replace NaN voxels (e.g. with 0) before labelling or training.

rules.title: NIfTI mask grid differs from its image
rules.fix: Resample the mask onto the image grid (same shape and affine).
